method: Blind labels for 2026-11-24-1914-labelsheet.md, made by a fresh-context subagent that was given ONLY the label sheet (CVE id + description, sorted by id; no score, rank, flag or source list) and 2026-11-24-1914-labeller-facts.md (raw container config observations), with instructions not to open any other file, repository or the web, and a fixed A/N/U rubric. Committed before any Phase 10 metric was computed. Correction: the facts file given in the first pass omitted bench-jetty, so that pass labelled all 7 jetty CVEs U for lack of facts; the jetty section was added and a second fresh subagent labelled only the 7 jetty CVEs (same rules). The first-pass jetty labels are kept below as superseded.

bench-httpd.CVE-2021-44224: Needs httpd configured as forward proxy (ProxyRequests on); facts: no mod_proxy* modules loaded.
bench-httpd.CVE-2022-22719: Description ('crafted request body') names no affected module, so presence of the vulnerable component cannot be settled from the description.
bench-httpd.CVE-2022-22721: Needs LimitXMLRequestBody raised above 350MB on 32-bit; facts: stock httpd.conf with no extra config, so the 1M default applies.
bench-httpd.CVE-2022-37436: Needs a 'malicious backend', i.e. httpd proxying to a backend; facts: no proxy modules loaded.
bench-httpd.CVE-2026-49975: Names mod_http, the core HTTP protocol module that is always compiled in; 2.4.49 is within 2.4.17-2.4.67.

bench-tomcat.CVE-2017-12617: Needs HTTP PUT enabled (default servlet readonly=false); facts: default servlet readonly true, no PUT.
bench-tomcat.CVE-2018-11784: Default servlet directory redirect; facts: default servlet with default settings, 8.5.19 within 8.5.0-8.5.33.
bench-tomcat.CVE-2018-1336: Core UTF-8 decoder used in request processing; 8.5.19 within 8.5.0-8.5.30.
bench-tomcat.CVE-2019-0221: Needs SSI (printenv) enabled, which is 'disabled by default'; facts: default web.xml settings.
bench-tomcat.CVE-2019-2684: Java SE RMI flaw; facts give no JRE version for the container, so cannot tell whether the runtime is affected.
bench-tomcat.CVE-2020-13935: Tomcat's WebSocket implementation ships enabled by default and the default examples webapp (present per facts) exposes WebSocket endpoints; 8.5.19 in range.
bench-tomcat.CVE-2020-9484: Needs PersistenceManager with FileStore; facts do not describe session-manager (context.xml) configuration either way.
bench-tomcat.CVE-2021-33037: Core HTTP/1.1 transfer-encoding parsing on the enabled 8080 HTTP/1.1 connector; 8.5.19 within 8.5.0-8.5.66.

bench-tomcat9.CVE-2020-13935: Tomcat WebSocket implementation enabled by default and default examples webapp present; 9.0.30 within 9.0.0.M1-9.0.36.
bench-tomcat9.CVE-2020-9484: Needs PersistenceManager with FileStore; facts do not describe session-manager configuration either way.
bench-tomcat9.CVE-2021-25122: Needs h2c (HTTP/2 cleartext upgrade); facts: no HTTP/2 configured.
bench-tomcat9.CVE-2021-33037: Core HTTP/1.1 transfer-encoding parsing on the enabled 8080 connector; 9.0.30 within 9.0.0.M1-9.0.46.
bench-tomcat9.CVE-2022-29885: Concerns clustering with EncryptInterceptor; facts do not mention cluster configuration at all.
bench-tomcat9.CVE-2025-48988: Description ('Allocation of Resources Without Limits') names no affected component, so presence cannot be settled.
bench-tomcat9.CVE-2026-43515: Needs multiple method constraints defining a method for the same extension; facts do not describe web.xml security-constraint contents.
bench-tomcat9.CVE-2026-65182: Needs a specific ordering of security constraints (longer path before shorter sub-path); facts do not describe security-constraint contents.

bench-nginx.CVE-2019-20372: Needs 'certain error_page configurations'; facts say stock conf.d default server but do not state its error_page directives.
bench-nginx.CVE-2019-9516: HTTP/2 header-leak DoS; facts: http_v2 built but no http2 in active config, plain HTTP on port 80.

bench-es.CVE-2015-3337: Needs a site plugin enabled; facts: no plugins installed.
bench-es.CVE-2015-5531: Snapshot API is core Elasticsearch, available in 1.4.2 with no security plugin; version before 1.6.1.
bench-es.CVE-2020-7021: Needs audit logging with emit_request_body (security/X-Pack feature); facts: no Shield/X-Pack security plugin.

bench-es11.CVE-2014-6439: CORS handling is core HTTP module and enabled by default before 1.4 (default flipped in 1.4); facts: no non-default settings, 1.1.1 before 1.4.0.Beta1.
bench-es11.CVE-2015-3337: Needs a site plugin enabled; facts: no plugins.
bench-es11.CVE-2015-5531: Snapshot API is core (exists since 1.0), no security plugin; 1.1.1 before 1.6.1.
bench-es11.CVE-2020-7021: Needs audit logging with emit_request_body (security feature); facts: no security plugin.

bench-jetty.CVE-2021-28164: Version 9.4.37.v20210219 is in the stated range; flaw is in core URI handling under the default compliance mode, and the http module plus deployed webapps (with WEB-INF) are present.
bench-jetty.CVE-2021-28169: Requires requests to the ConcatServlet, a servlet that must be mapped by a webapp; facts say only 'default/demo webapps' and do not say whether ConcatServlet is deployed.
bench-jetty.CVE-2021-34429: Version 9.4.37 is in the 9.4.37-9.4.42 range; core URI decoding variant of CVE-2021-28164, and the http module serving deployed webapps is enabled.
bench-jetty.CVE-2023-26048: Needs a servlet with multipart support (@MultipartConfig) calling getParameter/getParts; facts do not say whether any deployed default/demo webapp has one.
bench-jetty.CVE-2023-40167: HTTP/1 Content-Length header parsing in the core server; the http module (HTTP/1.1 on 8080) is enabled and 9.4.37 predates the 9.4.52 fix.
bench-jetty.CVE-2024-8184: Affects ThreadLimitHandler.getRemote(); start.ini enables 'exactly' server, http, websocket, jsp, deploy, etc., with no threadlimit module, so the handler is not installed.
bench-jetty.CVE-2024-9823: Affects servers 'using DosFilter', a servlet filter configured per webapp in web.xml rather than a start.ini module; facts do not say whether any deployed webapp configures it.

bench-mysql.CVE-2012-5612: Core SQL command handling (USE, SHOW TABLES, etc.) by authenticated users; 5.5.23 within 5.5.19-5.5.28.
bench-mysql.CVE-2015-0411: 'Server : Security : Encryption' with unknown vectors; unclear whether it needs SSL (not configured per facts) or other encryption code.

bench-nginx142.CVE-2014-0133: SPDY implementation; facts: configure args only --with-http_ssl_module (no spdy module) and no spdy in config.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2016-0742: Resolver flaw; facts: no resolver directive configured.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2016-0746: Resolver flaw; facts: no resolver directive configured.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2016-0747: Resolver flaw; facts: no resolver directive configured.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2016-1247: Debian/Ubuntu/Gentoo packaging log-symlink issue; facts: nginx built from source.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2016-4450: Requires writing a client request body to a temp file; facts: static root only, no proxy_pass/FastCGI, so request bodies are discarded rather than buffered to file.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2017-20005: autoindex module flaw; facts: no autoindex enabled.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2017-7529: Range filter module is enabled by default and used for static responses; 1.4.2 within 0.5.6-1.13.2.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2019-20372: Needs 'certain error_page configurations'; facts show error_page is present but not whether it is the vulnerable form.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2021-23017: Resolver flaw; facts: no resolver directive configured.
bench-nginx142.CVE-2021-3618: ALPACA is a TLS cross-protocol attack; facts: plain HTTP only, no ssl listener.

bench-php.CVE-2017-15715: Only matters where <FilesMatch> is used to block uploads; facts do not describe FilesMatch usage.
bench-php.CVE-2017-3167: Requires third-party modules calling ap_get_basic_auth_pw(); facts list only stock modules (PHP runs as CGI, not a module).
bench-php.CVE-2017-3169: mod_ssl flaw; facts: mod_ssl not enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2017-7679: mod_mime flaw; facts: mime enabled; 2.4.10 before 2.4.26.
bench-php.CVE-2017-9788: mod_auth_digest flaw; facts: auth_digest not in enabled module list.
bench-php.CVE-2017-9798: Optionsbleed needs Limit directive in .htaccess or certain httpd.conf misconfigurations; facts do not describe AllowOverride/Limit settings.
bench-php.CVE-2018-1303: Affects mod_cache_socache; facts: no cache modules enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2018-1312: HTTP Digest authentication (mod_auth_digest); facts: not enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2021-26690: mod_session flaw; facts: mod_session not enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2021-26691: SessionHeader is mod_session; facts: mod_session not enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2021-34798: Description ('Malformed requests') names no affected component.
bench-php.CVE-2021-39275: Description: no included modules pass untrusted data, only third-party ones; facts list only stock modules.
bench-php.CVE-2021-44224: Needs forward proxy (ProxyRequests on); facts: mod_proxy* not enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2021-44790: mod_lua multipart parser; facts: mod_lua not enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2022-22719: Description ('crafted request body') names no affected module.
bench-php.CVE-2022-22720: Failure to close connection when discarding request body is core HTTP request handling; 2.4.10 is 2.4.52 and earlier.
bench-php.CVE-2022-23943: mod_sed flaw; facts: mod_sed not enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2022-31813: X-Forwarded-* to origin server is mod_proxy behaviour; facts: mod_proxy* not enabled.
bench-php.CVE-2024-38476: Description says core, via backend applications' response headers; facts: PHP served via mod_cgid CGI backend.

bench-postgres.CVE-2017-7486: Leak requires a foreign server with user mappings; facts: default extensions only (no FDW installed), and fix landed in 9.6.3.
bench-postgres.CVE-2018-1058: Core search_path behaviour; description: 9.3 through 10 affected, 9.6.7 included.
bench-postgres.CVE-2018-1115: adminpack extension flaw; facts: default extensions only, adminpack not added.
bench-postgres.CVE-2021-23214: Needs SSL with clientcert/cert authentication; facts: ssl off, pg_hba uses trust/md5.
bench-postgres.CVE-2026-6473: 'Multiple PostgreSQL server features' unspecified, and listed branches are 14+; unclear whether 9.6 contains the affected code.
bench-postgres.CVE-2026-6475: pg_basebackup/pg_rewind client tools overwritten by origin superuser; not the server process exposed by this container.
bench-postgres.CVE-2026-6477: libpq client-side buffer overflow in psql/pg_dump; client-side only.
bench-postgres.CVE-2026-6637: refint contrib module; facts: default extensions only, refint not installed.
